concerns.text: FR-001 (N≥15 participants) and SC-001/002/003 (metrics) require a defined recruitment and assignment mechanism. Task T070 (Generate Statistical Methodology) is marked incomplete [ ], yet T073b (Recruitment Tracking) and T014b (Real Assignment) depend on the protocol defined in T070. Without a completed T070, the plan lacks the necessary statistical power analysis and pre-specified analysis approach required to justify the N=15-20 pilot size and the Welch's ANOVA method. This blocks the implementation of the core experiment.

FR-005 and the Plan's 'Critical Methodological Shift' require a pre-specified analysis approach (Welch's ANOVA) and verified citations. Task T071b (Execute Reference-Validator Gate) is marked incomplete [ ]. The Plan states this is a 'blocking gate' before Phase 1. Without this gate passing, the project cannot proceed to implement the analysis pipeline (US-3) or the experiment (US-1) with verified accuracy, violating Constitution Principle II.

FR-009 requires repository selection based on a rubric (high-quality docs, LOC/CC matching). Task T021f (Verify Rubric Gate) is marked incomplete [ ]. This gate blocks T076 (Generate Docs) and T021e. Without a passed gate, the system cannot guarantee the selected repositories meet the 'high-quality human documentation' criteria or the ±15% tolerance, invalidating the comparison baseline for US-2 and US-3.

FR-001 requires managing assignment of N≥15 participants. Task T014b (Real Participant Assignment) is marked incomplete [ ] and depends on T073b (Recruitment) and T070/T071b. Since the prerequisite gates (T070, T071b) and the recruitment system (T073b) are not verified, there is no task covering the actual implementation of the real participant assignment logic required for the feasibility pilot. The mock assignment (T014c) is insufficient for the real experiment requirement.

US-1 and FR-001 require executing the experiment with real participants. Task T075b (Execute real onboarding experiment) is marked incomplete [ ]. It depends on T076 (Docs) and T014b (Assignment). Since T076 depends on T021f (Gate) and T014b depends on T073b/T070/T071b, and all these upstream tasks are incomplete, there is no path to execute the real experiment. The task exists but is unreachable due to missing upstream coverage.

FR-007 and SC-005 require the analysis pipeline to run within 6h/7GB. Task T036b-exec (Execute T036b-logic) is marked incomplete [ ]. It depends on T036b (Implementation) and the Phase 0 gates. Without the implementation of T036b (also incomplete) and the validation of the research protocol (T071b), the primary analysis required to answer the research question cannot be performed.

Task T071a (Implement Reference-Validator) is marked [X] (complete) but has a comment '<!-- FAILED: unspecified -->'. This indicates a stale or broken state. While the task exists, the 'FAILED' status suggests the implementation is not actually valid, creating a false sense of coverage for the Reference-Validator requirement (Constitution Principle II). The task needs to be re-evaluated or the status corrected to reflect the actual state.

Task T003 (Configure linting) is marked [X] but has a comment '<!-- FAILED: unspecified -->'. Similar to T071a, this indicates a discrepancy between the task status and its actual state, potentially masking a missing implementation of the linting configuration required for code quality.
